name: Quiz Buzzers
author: buildwithnoknok
description: A game-show buzzer set for family quiz night: one LED Button per team (2 to 4 teams). First to press answers; the quizmaster taps the team's button for wrong, holds it for right. Display keeps the score, buzzer counts you in.
assembly_guide: Connect the four LED Buttons, the Buzzer and the Display to the PicoHub with JST SH cables (use a Qwiic hub for the extra ports).
Put one LED Button in front of each team.
Plug the Pico into power and run setup in the noknok app.

controls.action: False start: that team is red and out for this question
The first team to press lights up in its colour and answers
Wrong: the team is out for this question, the others can buzz again

controls.control: Hold the answering team's button (1 s)
controls.action: Right: the team scores a point

controls.control: Hold a button or the knob while plugging in
controls.action: Factory reset - keep holding until the LEDs flash / the buzzer confirms (about 8 s)

config_schema.label: 3-2-1 countdown (false starts)
config_schema.help: Off = buttons are live as soon as a question starts
